binary_path.description: The absolute path to the openSeaChest_Basics executable.

target_device.description: The default block device node to target for diagnostics.

output_format.description: The format for command output: 'json' or 'text'.

verbose_logging.description: Enable verbose output for debugging drive interactions.

log_path.description: Path to the log file for storing diagnostic results.

lib_path.description: Directory containing the opensea-transport and opensea-operations libraries.

check_updates.description: Whether to check for firmware updates or new tool versions.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for communication with the drive.

color_output.description: Enable colorized output for terminal readability.
